definitions.explanation: An overflow of water that submerges land which is usually dry, often caused by heavy rain, river overflow, or dam failure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{氾濫|はんらん}→氾濫：09256_hanran⟧し、{洪水|こうずい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: Heavy rain caused the river to overflow, resulting in a flood.

examples.japanese: {洪水|こうずい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多く：18752_ooku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浸水|しんすい}した→浸水する：14945_shinsui⟧。
examples.english: Many houses were flooded due to the flood.

examples.japanese: {洪水|こうずい}⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{堤防|ていぼう}→堤防：19409_teibou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{作|つく}られた→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: A levee was built to prevent flood damage.

notes:
{洪水|こうずい} refers to large-scale flooding, typically caused by heavy rain, river overflow, or typhoons.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan experiences frequent flooding during the ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧ (rainy season) and ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧ (typhoon) season. {洪水|こうずい}⟦ハザードマップ→ハザードマップ：noentry⟧ are widely distributed by local governments.
